name: TrueLayer
desc: Connect with TrueLayer to leverage secure open banking services. This integration allows seamless interaction with TrueLayer's API to manage various financial processes.

actions.name: create-payout
actions.description: Pay out from one of your merchant accounts.

actions.name: get-payout
actions.description: Returns payout details.

actions.name: start-payout-authorization-flow
actions.description: Start the authorization flow for a payout. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payout you are trying to fetch.

actions.name: submit-payments-provider-return-parameters
actions.description: Submit direct return query and fragment parameters returned from the provider.

actions.name: create-mandate
actions.description: Create a new mandate. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: list-mandate
actions.description: List all the mandates associated with the client. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: get-mandate
actions.description: Returns a mandate with the stated ID. This endpoint can be called either by the regular `backend token` or the `mandate token` for that mandate.

actions.name: start-mandate-authorization-flow
actions.description: Start the authorization flow for a mandate. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: submit-consent-mandate
actions.description: Submit the consent given by the user. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: submit-mandate-provider-selection
actions.description: Submit the provider details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: revoke-mandate
actions.description: Revoke a mandate. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: confirm-mandate-funds
actions.description: Confirm that the PSU has the given funds. This API can be called using the mandate_token associated with the mandate or using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: get-constraints
actions.description: Retrieve the constraints defined on the mandate, as well as the current utilization of those constraints within the periods.

actions.name: list-operating-accounts
actions.description: List all your TrueLayer merchant accounts. There might be more than one account per currency.

actions.name: get-operating-account
actions.description: Get the details of a single merchant account.

actions.name: merchant-account-get-transactions
actions.description: Get the transactions of a single merchant account. If pagination is missing, add a header `tl-enable-pagination: true` to enable pagination.

actions.name: merchant-account-setup-sweeping
actions.description: Set the automatic sweeping settings for a merchant account. At regular intervals, any available balance in excess of the configured `max_amount_in_minor` is withdrawn to a pre-configured IBAN.

actions.name: merchant-account-disable-sweeping
actions.description: Disable automatic sweeping for a merchant account.

actions.name: merchant-account-get-sweeping
actions.description: Get the automatic sweeping settings for a merchant account.

actions.name: get-merchant-account-payment-sources
actions.description: Get the payment sources from which the merchant account has received payments.

actions.name: create-payment-link
actions.description: Create a new payment link. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: get-payment-link
actions.description: Retrieves payment link details. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: get-payment-link-payments
actions.description: List all the payments associated with the payment link. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: create-payment
actions.description: Create a new payment. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

actions.name: start-payment-authorization-flow
actions.description: Start the authorization flow for a payment. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: submit-provider-selection
actions.description: Submit the provider details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: submit-scheme-selection
actions.description: Submit the scheme details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: submit-form
actions.description: Submit form details filled by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: submit-consent
actions.description: Submit the consent given by the user. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: submit-user-account-selection
actions.description: Submit the user account selection option given by the user. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: cancel-payment
actions.description: Cancel a payment. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: save-user-account-payment
actions.description: Save the account details associated with a payment for subsequent re-use. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: get-payment
actions.description: Returns payment details. This API can be called using either the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

actions.name: create-payment-refund
actions.description: Refund a merchant account payment, either fully or partially.

actions.name: get-payment-refunds
actions.description: Returns all refunds of a payment.

actions.name: get-payment-refund
actions.description: Returns refund details for a specific payment.

actions.name: search-payment-providers
actions.description: Returns a list of payment providers.

actions.name: get-payment-provider
actions.description: Returns payment provider details. This API can be called without the need for authentication.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

guides.title: TrueLayer automation
guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on TrueLayer automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.
